main_body: conical thatched-roof hut with mud-brick wall
top_band: layered yellow-brown thatched roof cone from row 0 to row 58 (around row 48 above the central doorway arch), overhanging the mud-brick wall
evidence: The large conical thatched roof (rows 0-58) clearly presents its top/sloped surface from above with layered ring-steps, overhanging the vertical cylindrical mud-brick wall face below (rows 59-78) with a clear eave shadow (rows 59-61) and an inset dark doorway opening.

style.evidence: The thatched roof has a rich 6-step yellow-ochre ramp with per-bundle vertical grass grain and horizontal step shadows, while the cylindrical wall has 3-zone directional shading, brick dashes, eave cast shadow, and a stone plinth; outlines use dark brown material tones matching Beodeul's craft.
